description: Generate a dispute letter for a specific fee. Use when you have a clear case for a refund or reversal. Do NOT use when you need to analyze multiple fees; use audit_fees instead.

company.description: Company or bank that charged the fee

date_charged.description: Optional date the fee was charged

fee_name.description: Name of the fee being disputed

requested_action.description: What to ask for, e.g. 'reverse or refund' or 'waive'; default 'reverse or refund'

your_name.description: Your name, used to sign the letter

name: dispute_letter

letter.description: The full text of the dispute letter.

recipient.description: The recipient of the letter, inferred from the company name.

subject.description: The subject line of the letter.

title: Dispute letter
